er, pursuant to House Resolution 936, I 
call up the bill (S. 1071) to require the 
Secretary of Veterans Affairs to dis-
inter the remains of Fernando V. Cota 
from Fort Sam Houston National Cem-
etery, Texas, and for other purposes, 
and ask for its immediate consider-
ation in the House.

IMPSON). Pursuant to House Resolu-

of a substitute consisting of the text of 
Rules Committee Print 119–16 is adopt-
ed, and the bill, as amended, is consid-
ered read.

follows: 
S. 1071 
Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Rep-
resentatives of the United States of America in 
Congress assembled, 
SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE. 
This Act may be cited as the ‘‘National De-
fense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026’’. 
SEC. 2. ORGANIZATION OF ACT INTO DIVISIONS; 
TABLE OF CONTENTS. 
(a) D IVISIONS.—This Act is organized into 8 
divisions as follows: 
(1) Division A—Department of Defense Au-
thorizations.

izations. 
(3) Division C—Department of Energy Na-
tional Security Authorizations and Other Au-
thorizations. 
(4) Division D—Funding Tables.

ization Act for Fiscal Year 2026. 
(6) Division F—Intelligence Authorization Act 
for Fiscal Year 2026. 
(7) Division G—Coast Guard Authorization 
Act of 2025. 
(8) Division H—Other Matters.
